CRITICAL DATA BUGS FOUND: 1) Database missing ~10-15 trades, 2) Position tracking broken - P/L using wrong entry prices, 3) TAO trade recorded as +$0.58 win but actually -$2.67 loss, 4) LEGACY path creating fake profits. True performance UNKNOWN. Matthew caught multiple reporting errors. Need to stop & fix tracking before continuing.

REAL PERFORMANCE FROM COINBASE API: 76 fills, 35 sells (22W/14L), 61.1% WR, LOSING -$2.37. Bot stopped. Database had only 20 exits vs 35 actual. Position tracking completely broken. All my earlier reports were WRONG - bot is unprofitable.
